p: hide thyself from them: As though your did not see it.
nigh unto thee: Showing that brotherly affection must be shown, not only to those who dwell near to us, but also to those who are far off.
ass: You are bound to do much more for your neighbour.
woman shall not wear that which: For that alters the order of nature, and shows that you despise God.
thou shalt not take the dam: If God detests cruelty done to little birds, how much more to man, made according to his image?
sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: The tenor of this law is to walk in simplicity and not to be curious about new fads.
occasions of speech against her: That is, be an occasion that she is slandered.
cloth before the elders of the: Meaning, the sheet, in which the signs of her virginity were.
of the damsel: For the fault of the child becomes the shame of the parents: therefore he was recompensed when she was faultless.
is this matter: Meaning, that the innocent cannot be punished.
take his father's wife: He shall not lie with his stepmother, meaning by this all other variations forbidden in Le 18:1-30.
